title: EEG: Attended Speaker Paradigm (Own Name in Ignored Stream)
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 25 participants performing a two-competing-speaker auditory attention paradigm, in which listeners attended to one of two simultaneously presented audio books. The paradigm examined the cocktail party effect, including detection of participants' own names embedded in the ignored stream, under omnidirectional and beamforming (spatial enhancement) listening conditions. The dataset supports research on selective auditory attention and neural tracking of speech.
methods_description: 25 participants attended to one of two competing audio books across five 10-minute blocks. In each block, the participant's own name was presented 10 times within the to-be-ignored stream. Blocks alternated between an omnidirectional condition (both audio books equally loud) and a beamforming condition (attended audio book louder), with the first block always omnidirectional and starting condition counterbalanced across participants.
